result.summary: The image shows a narrow residential street with continuous sidewalks but a complete lack of pedestrian crossing infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or curb ramps. The environment is further degraded by poor pavement conditions, including road patches and debris on the walkway, which pose tripping hazards.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no painted markings to indicate where pedestrians should cross the street at the intersection.

hazards.name: Missing curb ramps
hazards.description: The lack of sloped curb transitions makes the crossing inaccessible for people with mobility aids or strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner of the sidewalk in the foreground

hazards.name: Sidewalk debris and uneven pavement
hazards.description: Loose rocks and uneven pavement on the sidewalk near the building steps create a trip hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side sidewalk near the brick building

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian space and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped ramps at the corners to ensure accessibility for all users.

interventions.title: Sidewalk and Roadway Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the roadway and repair damaged sections of the sidewalk to remove trip hazards and improve drainage.

result.summary: This is a narrow residential street lined with multi-story row houses and continuous parallel parking on both sides. While sidewalks are provided, the environment lacks formal crossing infrastructure or traffic calming measures, and parked vehicles significantly limit visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Parked cars on both sides of the street block sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs throughout the visible block

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at potential crossing points to improve visibility and reduce crossing distance.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement vertical speed control to maintain low vehicle speeds on this residential street.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is a residential street currently undergoing roadwork, resulting in significant sidewalk obstructions and poor pavement quality. While a dedicated walkway exists, the lack of a buffer from the roadway and the presence of construction debris create a hazardous and inaccessible path.

hazards.name: Construction Obstructions
hazards.description: Large concrete cylinders and orange barrels block the majority of the sidewalk width.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and right side of the sidewalk

hazards.name: Degraded Sidewalk Surface
hazards.description: The concrete sidewalk is heavily cracked and uneven, posing a trip hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the foreground and mid-ground walkway

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the sidewalk to provide a smooth, ADA-compliant walking surface.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Maintenance of Traffic (MOT)
interventions.description: Ensure that construction activities provide a clear, signed, and protected bypass for pedestrians when the main walkway is blocked.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffers
interventions.description: Install a planting strip or street trees between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical and psychological separation from vehicles.

result.summary: This residential street features narrow sidewalks directly adjacent to the roadway with no buffer. A large vehicle is parked on or very close to the walkway, creating a significant obstruction for pedestrians, while the road surface is in poor condition with visible patching.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A black pickup truck is parked partially on the narrow sidewalk, forcing pedestrians into the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image, in front of the white building.

hazards.name: Poor Road Surface
hazards.description: The asphalt is heavily patched and uneven, creating potential trip hazards and poor drainage.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center of the roadway.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Obstruction Removal
interventions.description: Increase the effective width of the sidewalk and implement physical barriers or enforcement to prevent vehicles from parking on the walkway.

interventions.title: Pavement Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Resurface the roadway to provide a smooth, predictable surface for all users.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Add a buffer zone with trees or bollards to separate pedestrians from moving and parked vehicles.
